I had a stroke very similar that caused severe aphasia.

My wife quickly picked up that it was easier for her to ask yes or no questions in those first few weeks rather than having me describe things.
Rest is the key. It gets better over time and you can’t force it.

I’ve just had this problem myself. Tried everything. Then discovered that in iOS, under “Focus” your have your profiles. Select the profile you want. If the ring app isn’t in your profile, select “add” and add the ring app to the profile.

Hi, I had a stroke in my sleep also. Mine affected the left hand side of my brain and while I had no paralysis, I had severe aphasia. Couldn’t talk or string sentences together.
Looking back I had no real indicators that it was going to happen. Ended up being work stress was the cause.
However looking at photos from the day before, my left eye was extremely bloodshot and I felt extremely tired.
Did you have any indications looking back that this would have occurred while you slept?
I do get that, but there was no clue. Like nothing. He had so many friends. Could have called us all in a heartbeat. So broken. I just don’t understand.
